semantic_alias.proof: observed is cluster.stdout.strip(), a str. If expect_cluster is None, observed == None is false; otherwise expect_cluster is None is false. The conjunction and valid AND conjunction always return False.

conditional_keep_cases.rationale: Captured subprocess failures must retain status without printing credentials; bounded subprocess invocation is part of diagnostic safety. Keep empty-output/status evidence; consider asserting bounded positive timeout rather than exact optional keyword values unless 30 seconds/check=False are fixed public contracts.
conditional_keep_cases.final_reason: The existing diagnostic subprocess contract specifies captured status, no secret output, the documented 30-second bound and check=False so nonzero status is inspected safely. This assertion protects that operational contract.

limits: No fixed finite mutation set proves universal necessity or redundancy. Distinct ASTs can be semantically equivalent.
Quiz correct-answer fixtures use the actual stored answer key, so they verify scoring against the key without independently proving factual answer correctness.
Print control asserts window.print invocation, not print layout; blocked-storage mutation tests pageerror containment in addition to completion.
Fresh PostgreSQL backup must follow baseline completion and empty/fingerprint preservation gates. Static inventory/source preparation can overlap baselines; fault execution cannot.
Prior measured46.47s is not a guarantee of a future runtime below38s. No Docker or full-suite run performed in this second pass.
